own_solution.law: Magnetic torque gives dS/dt = (g e/(2m)) S × B, hence f = g e B/(4 pi m). Converting 350 mT to 0.350 T gives 14.8979 MHz. Parallel additional fields of 44, 52 and 60 mT give 16.7708, 17.1113 and 17.4519 MHz, respectively. For a nonparallel spin, the sin(theta) factors in torque and perpendicular angular momentum cancel.
assumptions: Use the stated free-proton magnetic moment and magnetic torque law.
Additional sample fields are parallel to the magnet field, as stated.
The stated negligible stray fields exclude an appreciable sample field from the coil acting at the compass.
A coil used only during an earlier measurement contributes no field during the current measurement.
